mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE') AS table_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'public') AS view_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema = 'public') AS trigger_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public') AS index_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM zh_article) AS article_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM article_snapshot) AS snapshot_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM zh_author) AS author_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM article_note) AS note_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM search_task) AS search_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM search_task WHERE result_cnt = 0) AS gap_cnt

SELECT b.batch_id, b.source_note, b.started_at, b.finished_at, b.status, b.fetched_cnt, b.inserted_cnt, b.updated_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM article_snapshot s WHERE s.batch_id = b.batch_id) AS snapshot_cnt FROM crawl_batch b ORDER BY b.batch_id DESC
